entries.reason: The statement quantifies over an undefined theta profile, an unspecified set of registered moments, and every polynomial-bit dual statistic exposed by a grammar. The statistic interface is neither finite nor canonical and can include an encoded SAT decision bit, so the claim has no stable falsification semantics.
salvage: H078 fixes one encoding, monomial basis, objective list, equality notion, and explicit family requirement.
H081-H082 isolate the finite rational certificate interface.
